text.en:
Increase in MAV of Pork. The MAV of pork meat for the MAV Year
2021 of 54,210 MT is hereby increased to 254,210 MT, provided that any unavailable
balance at the end of 2021 shall not be carried over to 2022.

Allocation of MAV to Importers. The MAV Management
Committee is hereby directed to ensure that the allocation of the volume importation
is fair and open to all qualified importers of pork meat, and in accordance with existing
rules and regulations for the implementation of the agricultural MAs, and other
pertinent laws and regulations.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 10 tiday of
, in the year of our
Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty One.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPTNES
Office of the President
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
ATTY. COMCEPCZON
